description: Projection-pushdown auto-rewrite (desugar_pushdown) golden documents. Each fixture pairs an INPUT document with the GOLDEN rewritten document the Julia reference emits. Bindings run their own desugar_pushdown on the parsed input and deep-compare the result to the parsed golden (numeric equality by value, key order free); they must also assert idempotency (desugaring the golden returns it unchanged) and input purity (the input document is not mutated). Files are canonical JSON (sorted keys, 2-space indent) for byte-stable re-emission via scripts/generate-pushdown-goldens.jl.
